A dense '''star cluster''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] near the border of the satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] [[Firefist]]. It contained the [[Nagi system/Legends|Nagi system]], including 9 planets and 11 moons.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
